Bootstrap 5.3.3 and Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3, kept here so the system needs no internet access:

  assets/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css
  assets/vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
  assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css
  assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2
  assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff

The pages use these local files. If one is removed, that page falls back to the copy on cdn.jsdelivr.net.
The licences are in LICENSE.txt in each folder. The fonts (Barlow, Barlow Semi Condensed, Share Tech Mono)
are in assets/fonts with their OFL licences.
